cancellation: caller context cancellation terminates the request; shutdown uses bounded context
compatibility_policy: source and protocol identities must match this record
containment: service panic or process exit cannot unwind into the caller
malformed_input: unknown fields, trailing JSON, oversized body, wrong method, wrong path, wrong content type, missing id, version mismatch, and out-of-range value reject
nullability: JSON fields are required; null and missing fields reject
ownership: client and service retain independent request and response buffers

resource_limits.request_concurrency: HTTP server bounded by host process policy

retry: no automatic retry in Wave Four
timeout: one-second HTTP server limits plus caller context
unknown_conditions: kernel and HTTP stack behavior outside declared hosts
